Mary De Morgan, The Necklace of Princess Fiorimonde.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/mary-de-morgan/the-necklace-of-princess-fiorimonde

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Mary De Morgan, the author, died 1907.

First publication of the text used: 1886 (SE colophon: 'The Necklace of Princess Fiorimonde was published in 1886 by Mary De Morgan.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1886, before 1931. A published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so it entered by 1981.
- Country of origin (every country): every person named above died in 1925 or earlier, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less. The last to die did so in 1907.
